summary: Frontend-only testing of the phpMirror write-through fix (Klinik Kana). Verified via page.on('request') + window.__phpMirror debug hook that the axios wiring is correct: debug hook present, IS_PHP===false, BASE===REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, no-op behaviour in LOCAL mode confirmed (0 .php requests during real UI mutations), and all 17 endpoint shapes (customers/spareparts/repairs/parts/payments/users/settings) fire with the correct METHOD + URL + query + JSON body. Full LOCAL-mode regression passed (login admin/admin123, customer create/edit/delete, sparepart create/delete, repair addPayment/addPart/removePart/changeStatus, invoice A4+thermal print page, all 7 nav pages). HOWEVER a critical cross-checked defect was found by diffing phpMirror payloads against /app/php-backend/api/*.php: the local store uses STRING ids (uid() -> 'c_l9x..', seed 'sp1'/'r1'/'c1') while every PHP endpoint does (int)$_GET['id'] / (int)$b['customer_id'], so on the real VPS all mirrored UPDATE/DELETE/addPart/addPayment calls will be rejected and repair creates will break FK. The write-through therefore will NOT fix the user's reported MySQL bug beyond a partial customer/sparepart/user INSERT.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing React hydration console error: <span> rendered as child of <option> (visual-editor instrumentation on dynamic option text). Not caused by this change but pollutes console.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL ID TYPE MISMATCH. phpMirror sends the localStorage id (e.g. ?id=c1, ?id=sp3, ?id=r_l9xab12). Every PHP endpoint does `$id = (int)$_GET['id']` -> 0 -> json_error('id wajib', 400). So customer.upsert(existing), customer.remove, sparepart.upsert/remove/adjustStock, repair.upsert/changeStatus/remove, repair.removePart, repair.removePayment will ALL fail on the VPS. User's 'MySQL tidak berubah' bug will persist for every edit/delete.

POST /api/repairs/index.php requires numeric customer_id (FK to customers.id). Local repair carries customer_id='c1'/'c_xxx' -> (int)0 -> FK constraint failure / 500. New tickets will never reach MySQL.
POST body sends local sparepart_id string -> parts.php casts (int) -> 0 -> json_error('sparepart_id wajib'). Part usage never mirrors to MySQL and stock in MySQL drifts from UI.

store.js line 535 passes `removed?.sparepart_id` as the `part_id` argument. parts.php expects the repair_parts ROW id (SELECT ... FROM repair_parts WHERE id=?). Semantically wrong even if ids were numeric — would delete the wrong row or fail.

POST responses (which contain the MySQL auto-increment id) are discarded by fire-and-forget. The local record keeps its uid() string id, so every later update/delete of that record can never target the MySQL row. Write-through is create-only and permanently divergent.

All mirror failures are swallowed with console.warn only. The UI shows success while MySQL is untouched — this is exactly the symptom the user reported. No toast / no retry / no sync-health indicator.

In PHP mode reads are NOT mirrored. Existing MySQL rows on the VPS are invisible in the admin UI, and localStorage seed demo data is shown instead — user will still say 'database belum sesuai'. Also no multi-device/multi-browser consistency.

phpMirror sends the whole local object including `__isNew: true`, local `id`, `branch_id`, `created_at`. Harmless for the current PHP handlers (they cherry-pick fields) but `branch_id` is silently dropped, so branch assignment never reaches MySQL.

action_items: Persist a MySQL id mapping: after a successful mirror POST, read the returned row id and store it on the local record (e.g. `php_id`), then use `php_id` for all subsequent PUT/DELETE/addPart/addPayment mirror URLs. Skip the mirror when no php_id exists.
Map relational ids too: repair.customer_id, addPart.sparepart_id, technician_id must be translated to the MySQL php_id before mirroring, otherwise repairs/parts inserts fail on FK.
Fix store.js:535 — repairsApi.removePart must pass the repair_parts row id (or the mapped php part id), not `removed.sparepart_id`.
Same for removePayment: local 'pay_xxx' id must be mapped to the MySQL payments.id.

Either loosen PHP endpoints to accept string external ids (add an `ext_id` column + lookup) OR do the mapping client-side — the string-vs-(int) mismatch is the single root cause and must be fixed before the VPS behaviour changes.
Surface mirror failures to the user (toast / persistent 'MySQL out of sync' badge) instead of console.warn-only, so the 'database doesn't change' symptom is visible.
Consider mirroring READS in PHP mode (or a one-time bootstrap import) so the admin UI reflects MySQL instead of localStorage seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: phpMirror URL/method/body shapes are correct and were network-verified, but the ID CONTRACT is wrong: localStorage uses uid() strings ('c_l9x..', seed 'sp1'/'r1') while every /app/php-backend/api endpoint does `(int)$_GET['id']`. All mirrored PUT/DELETE resolve to id=0 -> 400 'id wajib'.
Fire-and-forget with a swallowing .catch() means the app can never detect divergence; at minimum log a structured error and set a global sync-failed flag.
phpMirror POST discards the server response, losing the only chance to capture the MySQL primary key.
store.js repairsApi.removePart passes sparepart_id where the PHP endpoint expects the repair_parts row id.

IS_PHP is captured once at module load into window.__phpMirror; acceptable for a debug hook, but note the hook exposes an unguarded _fire() in production builds — gate it behind NODE_ENV !== 'production'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: REACT_APP_DATA_MODE is still 'local' (unchanged, as instructed). Use window.__phpMirror._fire(method, url, body) + page.on('request') to verify endpoint shapes without a PHP server; all 17 shapes were confirmed correct in iteration 9. The remaining work is the string-id vs (int) id mapping between /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js|phpMirror.js and /app/php-backend/api/**/*.php. After the main agent adds id mapping, re-verify that mirror URLs carry the mapped numeric php_id (e.g. ?id=12) rather than 'c1'/'r_xxx', and that repairs POST body customer_id is numeric. LOCAL-mode regression (login, customer CRUD, sparepart CRUD, repair payments/parts/status, invoice print, all nav pages) is green and needs no re-testing unless store.js changes shape.
rca_of_the_issue: The write-through wiring itself is implemented correctly — network capture proves every mutation fires the intended METHOD + URL + JSON payload to the PHP endpoints, and it correctly no-ops when REACT_APP_DATA_MODE=local. The fix will still NOT resolve the user's 'MySQL tidak berubah' complaint on the VPS because of an identifier contract mismatch: the localStorage store generates opaque string primary keys (uid() -> 'c_l9xab12'; seed data uses 'c1','sp1','r1') whereas every PHP handler coerces ids with (int) casts against MySQL AUTO_INCREMENT integer keys. Consequently ?id=c1 becomes 0 and the handler returns 400 'id wajib' for all UPDATE/DELETE mirrors; POST /api/repairs/index.php receives customer_id='c1' -> (int)0 and violates the customers FK; parts.php receives sparepart_id='sp1' -> 0 and rejects. Because rawFire swallows errors with console.warn and never reads the POST response, the client also never learns the real MySQL id, so no record can ever be re-targeted. Repro: set REACT_APP_DATA_MODE=php on the VPS, edit an existing customer, and observe 400 'id wajib' in the browser console / PHP access log while the UI reports success. Mitigation: capture the id from the mirror POST response into a local `php_id` field, translate all relational ids (customer_id, sparepart_id, technician_id, part row id, payment id) through that mapping before mirroring, fix store.js:535 to pass the repair_parts row id, and surface mirror failures in the UI.
